ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Autorun Registry Modified via WMI
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious activity where the WMIC process is used to create an autorun registry entry via reg.exe, which is often indicative of persistence mechanisms employed by malware.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\wmic\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "wmic\.exe" OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\wmiprvse\\\.exe$")) AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*reg.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ add\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Run.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\WOW6432Node\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Run.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\Explorer\\\\Run.*")))) AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Perflogs.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\ProgramData\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Temp.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Roaming.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\\\$Recycle\\\.bin.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\Default.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\public.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%temp\\%.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%tmp\\%.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%Public\\%.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%AppData\\%.*")) OR ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Favorites.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Favourites.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Contacts.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Music.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Pictures.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Documents.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Photos.*")))))
